Chapter 342: Chapter 6: Unifying the Black Mist Mountain Range, the True King Without a Crown (Subscribe Please)_2

But it was all in vain, as he was rapidly dragged away without the capacity to resist.

“What is that?”

It was only at this moment that the Giant Elephant King and the other five Demon Beast Kings noticed an imposing ancient tree standing not far away, the presence of which was previously unknown to them.

The ancient tree, black in color, towered unimaginably high and was shrouded in an evil, chaotic aura.

Just now, it was one of this tree’s countless vines that had dragged away the Divine Ape King.

“This is bad.”

...

The Giant Elephant King and the other Demon Beast Kings felt their scalps explode.

They had no idea when such a monstrous tree had appeared next to their lairs. If the Divine Ape King, with his strength, couldn’t withstand even one of its countless vines, how powerful was the entire tree?

As for the evil, chaotic aura that the Ancient God emitted… The minds of the Giant Elephant King and the other five Demon Beast Kings were in complete disarray, with no time to consider it carefully.

In the hearts of the six Demon Beast Kings, there was only one thought.

That was—

Run.

Run as far as possible.

Boom!!

The six terrifyingly powerful Demon Beast Kings.

Almost simultaneously, they dashed in six different directions.

Even in such a state of utter panic, the Demon Beast Kings instinctively chose different paths.

This way,

They could at least distract the attention of the terrifying ancient tree.

Rustle.

Six black vines descended from the towering ancient tree.

Five of the Demon Beast Kings struggled briefly against the entwining vines but were quickly dragged away just like the Divine Ape King.

Only the Giant Elephant King.

“Ahhhhh, break!!”

The massive body of the Giant Elephant King burst forth with earth-shaking power.

As a descendant of the ancient gods, the Giant Elephant King inherited part of the formidable life force of the ancient gods.

The ancient gods, it is said, did not originate from the Tianqing World but came from beyond its realms.

It was precisely because of the talents of the ancient gods that the Giant Elephant King was able to overpower the other seven Kings of the Black Mist Mountain Range and secure the throne of the strongest Demon Beast King.

In fact,

Not just in the Black Mist Mountain Range,

In the other nine mountain ranges of the Tianqing World and among the dozens of other Demon Beast Kings, the power of the Giant Elephant King was also considered terrifying, ranking within the top three or even number one.

Rumble.

Faced with the black vines that easily dragged away six Demon Beast Kings, the full potential of the Giant Elephant King was forced out, his blood boiled, and a huge phantom of a sacred elephant appeared behind him.

Crack.

Under the furious outbreak of the Giant Elephant King, the black vine slowly shattered.

“Did he break free?”

The expression of the Giant Elephant King turned wildly ecstatic.

From the moment the Divine Ape King was dragged away by the black vines to when the six Demon Beast Kings fell into the same fate.

To the Giant Elephant King, the black vines were like the grim reaper, exuding an immense oppressive force.

However, now.

With the Giant Elephant King unleashing his full potential and employing dozens of secret techniques to enhance his power, he had finally shattered the black vine, ensuring he wouldn’t be dragged away like the other Demon Beast Kings.

“My power, my lineage…”

The Giant Elephant King had barely felt joy when he suddenly turned his head and desperately discovered hundreds, thousands of black vines sweeping towards him.

“This…”

The face of the Giant Elephant King turned ashen.

He had hardly broken one black vine at a tremendous cost, only for hundreds or thousands of them to appear as soon as he turned around.

How was he supposed to cope?

Overwhelmed by despair,

this time the Giant Elephant King didn’t put up any resistance.

Instead, he nearly leapt into the midst of the black vines voluntarily, and then was dragged away.

…

“Yes, from today on, the Black Mist Mountain Range is completely mine…”

Lin Yuan’s figure rapidly shrank, influenced by Space Rules, even the seven enormous Demon Beast Kings also began to shrink quickly.

Wrapped in black vines, hanging below the branches.

Lin Yuan glanced at the seven Demon Beast Kings who had fallen into a deep sleep, with no intention to devour them.

If it had been before the Ancestral Demon Tree had made contact, facing such ‘delicacies’ as the Demon Beast Kings, Lin Yuan would have chosen to devour them immediately.

Just like he had swallowed the Phoenix King.

To quickly enhance his own strength and foundation.

But with the ‘feeding’ from the Ancestral Demon Tree, Lin Yuan lost interest in these ordinary flesh and souls.

Even if these Demon Beast Kings were strong and their vitality vigorous, could they really compare to the Origin Power of the Ancestral Demon Tree?

There was no comparison at all. The Origin Power of the Ancestral Demon Tree was the core strength of a Foreign Evil God.

Theoretically, as long as Lin Yuan devoured enough Origin Power of the Ancestor, he could replace the Ancestral Demon Tree and become a standalone Foreign Evil God.

“Let them stay for now, they’ll be useful later,” he said.

Lin Yuan did not kill those seven Demon Beast Kings; in future schemes, he might find a use for them.

For now, he just left them there.

At this moment, with the seven Demon Beast Kings plunged into deep sleep, they were as good as dead, not affecting Lin Yuan’s subsequent actions.

“Let’s begin,” he said.

With a slight movement of Lin Yuan’s mind,

Having dealt with the seven Demon Beast Kings, Lin Yuan, with no one left to fear, began to spread his roots toward the deepest parts of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

“Hmm? There’s a large Spirit Vein here, no wonder those Demon Beast Kings considered this area as their stronghold…”

Lin Yuan’s roots penetrated deep into the ground, ensnaring that abundant Spirit Vein, and began slowly devouring the pure spiritual power within it.

If the Origin Power fed by the Ancestral Demon Tree was the main course, then this large Spirit Vein was like a soup before the meal, just something casual to change the taste.

Several days later.

Lin Yuan’s roots had completely covered the deepest parts of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

That is to say,

The Black Mist Mountain Range, spanning millions of miles, was entirely under the control of Lin Yuan’s roots.

At this moment, Lin Yuan had truly become the ‘uncrowned king’ of the Black Mist Mountain Range, far surpassing the ‘uncrowned king’ title of the past Demon Beast Kings.

After all, the previous Demon Beast Kings of the Black Mist Mountain Range only nominally ruled the area, but Lin Yuan substantively controlled it, with his roots spread throughout every corner of the mountain range.

…

“Ancestor, the environment of the Black Mist Mountain Range is terribly harsh; just recently a few powerful demonic beasts nearly attacked me…”

Lin Yuan’s mind sank into the root area as he typically complained to the Ancestral Demon Tree.

“The Black Mist Mountain Range… It’s teeming with demonic beasts and is extremely dangerous; you really had it tough,” comforted the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Having fought with countless cultivators from Tianqing World until now, It had come to understand much information about the world.

Among them, the Black Mist Mountain Range was one of the top ten demonic beast mountain ranges of the Tianqing World, undoubtedly dangerous.

In the eyes of the Ancestral Demon Tree, the mere survival of Lin Yuan in the Black Mist Mountain Range was already a miracle.

“Here, I’ll give you some more Origin Power for self-protection,” said the Ancestral Demon Tree after some thought. Lin Yuan was its last hope for descending into the Tianqing World; how could it let him die at the hands of those beasts of the Black Mist Mountain Range?

“Thank you, Ancestor,” Lin Yuan said gratefully.

Indeed, in the view of Lin Yuan, the Ancestral Demon Tree was somewhat in a dilemma.

Over these ten years, the Ancestral Demon Tree had invested a vast amount of Origin Power into Lin Yuan.

This Origin Power could only be ‘recouped’ once the Ancestral Demon Tree descended into the Tianqing World.

But to descend into the Tianqing World, it needed to continue feeding Lin Yuan ‘Origin Power,’ putting the Ancestral Demon Tree in an awkward situation.

If it had been before contacting Lin Yuan, the Ancestral Demon Tree was not so set on acquiring the Tianqing World.

Being able to descend was naturally good; if it was otherwise unable to descend and the situation became deadlocked, leaving would also not involve substantial loss.

But now, if the Ancestral Demon Tree chose to leave, the losses would be significant, as so much of its Origin Power was within Lin Yuan.

If It gave up on the Tianqing World, it would likely not recover for thousands, perhaps tens of thousands of years.

“Losses are only temporary, the vision must be long-term; as long as I can descend into the Tianqing World, any great losses can be recouped and devouring an entire world’s Origin would be greatly beneficial to me…”

With this mindset, the Ancestral Demon Tree again allocated some of its Origin, sending it to Lin Yuan.
